artifacts.summary: Root-causes the whole-tree sentinel self-collision to scopes_overlap_first()'s exact-match clause in scripts/lib/file-scope-overlap.sh, confirms a single library fix reaches both orchestrate-batch-admit.sh and lint-roadmap-batch-proposals.sh, identifies orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's whole_tree_claim case arm as the actual width-1-serialization mechanism, and enumerates the fixture (test-orchestrate-batch-admit.sh's WHOLE-TREE-CODISPATCH) and doc updates (file-footprint-overlap.md, batch-orchestration-guardrails.md, batch-admit-schema.md) this deliberate design reversal requires.

memory_candidates.content: In agent-system/extensions/core, orchestrate-batch-admit.sh's defer_reason values only actually block dispatch if orchestrate-cycle-plan.sh's per-reason case arm (around line 2034) has no --allow-X bypass. A reason string claiming 'ORDERING CONSTRAINT, not an exclusion' in the admit script's own output is not itself evidence the cycle-plan consumer treats it that way -- check the case arm's bypass logic independently before trusting the reason prose.

scripts/lib/file-scope-overlap.sh is the single source of truth for the file_scope Overlap predicate (scopes_overlap_first), spliced via $FILE_SCOPE_OVERLAP_JQ_DEFS into any consumer's own jq -n program. A fix to the predicate's match clause reaches every splicing consumer (confirmed: orchestrate-batch-admit.sh and lint/lint-roadmap-batch-proposals.sh) with zero parallel edit -- always check this file first before assuming a file-scope-comparison bug needs fixing in each consumer separately.
